if (consumesKey(e.target, e.key)) return;
    const action = keyToUiAction(e.key);
why: Without the consume rule the roving focus takes ArrowDown away from a focused volume slider, which is the key the slider exists to consume.
killedBy: createHud roving-tabindex focus navigation (issue #115) leaves the volume slider in full control of its own arrow keys
hud: the semantic action dispatcher (issue #494) Escape is Back with a volume slider focused, while ArrowDown stays with the slider (the consume model)
